title: ETOS Messaging Events
description: Schema for the ETOS internal messaging events that are published to the RabbitMQ stream and streamed to clients over Server-Sent Events (SSE v2alpha). Each event is a JSON object with an 'event' type discriminator and a type specific 'data' payload. This schema is the source of truth for the event protocol ahead of the v2alpha -> v2 promotion. It should be renamed to v2 when the SSE protocol is promoted.

id.description: Monotonically increasing event id, assigned by the SSE server and used for resuming a stream.

event.description: The event type. Always lower case, matching the routing 'type' property.

meta.description: Routing meta value used for stream filtering (identifier.type.meta). Defaults to '*'.

data.description: Type specific payload. See the per-event definitions in $defs.

ping.description: Sent periodically to keep the connection between server and client alive. Server event.

error.description: An error from the messaging server. The client should reconnect. Server event.

unknown.description: An event that does not match any known type.

shutdown.description: The test run has finished. Always the last event. User event.

message.description: A user facing log message from ETOS. User event.

report.description: A test case report file. User event.

artifact.description: A test case artifact file. User event.

status.description: The current status of an ETOS service. User event.

result.description: The result of a test run, carried by a shutdown event.

conclusion.description: The overall conclusion of the test run.

verdict.description: The verdict of the test run.

description.description: A human readable description of the result.

log.description: A user facing log message, carried by a message event. Additional context fields are allowed.

name.description: The name of the logger that produced the message.

level.description: Log level, e.g. 'info' or 'error'. Published as 'level' (etos-library) or 'levelname' (etos); canonical form to be unified for v2.

levelname.description: Alias of 'level' used by the etos (Go) logger.

@timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the message was created.

identifier.description: The test run identifier the log belongs to.

file.description: A file, carried by a report or artifact event.

directory.description: The directory the file belongs to.

checksums.description: A map of checksum algorithm to checksum value.

serviceStatus.description: The health of an ETOS service, carried by a status event.

instance.description: The specific instance of the service.

message.description: A human readable message describing the status.
